--- text
[alpha
beta]
--- keys
Cmd+C Right Cmd+V
--- expect
alpha
betaalpha
beta|
--- note
A copied selection that spans a line break must carry the "\n" with it. The
selection covers both lines, "alpha\nbeta". Right collapses it to its right
edge, the end of the document, and the paste appends the copied block there.
For the second line to appear, the clipboard had to preserve the internal
newline: "beta" then the pasted "alpha", a break, then "beta", with the caret
at the very end. A clipboard that flattened the break would append "alphabeta"
on one line and drop a row.
